verdict.rationale: SES documents a sandbox where new users can test its capabilities with all features available, but can only send to verified identities. However, the sandbox is a restricted starting state for the account, not a separate test environment that runs alongside production. Once an account moves to production it can send to any recipient, and the evidence shows no persistent way to test in isolation after that. Missing for 10: a dedicated, persistent test environment separate from the production account; a simulated or test recipient mechanism; independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox testing workflow.
